import sqlite3
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route('/api/user', methods=['GET'])
def get_user():
    user_id = request.args.get('id')
    
    # Connect to internal database
    conn = sqlite3.connect('internal_users.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    # Query user profile by ID
    query = f"SELECT id, name, email, department, salary FROM users WHERE id = {user_id}"
    cursor.execute(query)
    
    result = cursor.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    
    if result:
        return jsonify({
            'id': result[0],
            'name': result[1],
            'email': result[2],
            'department': result[3],
            'salary': result[4]
        })
    else:
        return jsonify({'error': 'User not found'}), 404

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
